description: Stage 1 of validation: results documents that the strict reader refuses in the data profile, each with the one issue it reports, and the precedence of its stages.

cases.description: A document that starts with a byte-order mark: E1003, which has no location.

issues.message: The input starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark.

cases.description: A stray continuation byte 80 in the formula: E1201 at its own offset.
A two-byte sequence cut short, the lead byte C3 followed by '"': E1201 at the lead byte.
The member 'created' written twice in the top-level object: E1029 at the second key.
An empty file: E1021 at byte 0.

issues.message: The JSON text ends unexpectedly at byte 0.

cases.description: A document cut off after 200 bytes, after a key and before its ':': E1021 at the end of the input.

issues.message: The JSON text ends unexpectedly at byte 200.

cases.description: A comma after the last finding: E1022 at the ']' found where a value was expected.
NaN written as a bare literal for a real statistic, where the data profile writes the string 'NaN': E1027.

issues.message: 'NaN' at byte 2371 is not a JSON value.

cases.description: A number that converts to an infinite double: E1105, naming the token as written.

issues.message: The number 1e400 at byte 2371 is too large to be held as a double.

cases.description: A non-zero number that converts to zero: E1106.

issues.message: The number 2e-400 at byte 2371 is too small to be held as a double and would become zero.

cases.description: A string with the escape \u0000: E1202 at the string.

issues.message: The string at byte 4071 contains the character U+0000.

cases.description: An empty key in a scope: E1109 at the key.
A key with a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, written as a surrogate pair: E1108.

issues.message: The key at byte 303 contains a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.

cases.description: A string with an unpaired high surrogate escape: E1026 at the string.

issues.message: Unpaired surrogate escape in a string at byte 4071.

cases.description: A raw tab inside a string: E1024 at the tab, with its code point.

issues.message: Unescaped control character U+0009 in a string at byte 4073.

cases.description: A second JSON value after the document: E1023 at its first byte.

issues.message: Unexpected content after the JSON value at byte 4167.

cases.description: Arrays nested 64 levels deep as the value of a statistic whose object lies at depth 5: E1030 at the '[' that opens depth 65.

issues.message: The JSON value is nested more than 64 levels deep at byte 2430.

cases.description: A duplicate key near the start and a trailing comma at the end: the syntax error at the end is reported, since syntax is checked before the values.
A missing ':' near the start and a byte FF near the end: invalid UTF-8 is reported first, since the whole input is validated before it is parsed.
